name: sub_56492
role: enter the DSP link: state 0xFFB0A6 = 1, timer 0xFF9552 = 0x0A, bset bit0 of 0xFFFF52

name: sub_564B2
role: DSP power-on / reset: 0xFFB0A2 = 0x80, field at 0xFFFD6A = 0x10, set bit2 of 0xFFFB90 and 0xFFFF34, clear bit2 of 0xFFFF36

name: sub_564FA
role: after the reset delay: bset bits 1, 2, 3 of 0xFFFF52, restart the timer, state = 2

name: sub_56520
role: SCI_A synchronous init: SCR=0x02, SMR=0x80, BRR=0x00, clear SSR, SCR=0x12, then SCR |= RIE; state = 4

name: sub_56056
role: DSP shutdown: clear every 0xFFFF52 bit, clear bit4 of 0xFFFF59, reset all link state

name: sub_565C0 / sub_565EE / sub_56626
role: idle and timeout states; the TIME OUT:3sec! path

name: sub_566E4
role: transmit a command frame: SCR=0x22, 0xFFBC8C=1, ER5 = @0xFFB13A, jsr sub_4834E, spin until done, state = 5

name: sub_5678E
role: transmit the ACK/NAK frame from 0xFFB1A0 the same way, state = 7

name: sub_56732 / sub_567DC
role: switch back to receive: clear SSR flags, SCR=0x12, SCR |= RIE, state = 1

name: sub_4834E
role: DMA transmit engine: wait TDRE, program DMAC ch1 (source = ER5, dest = 0xFFFF8B, count 0x20 or 0x60), set SCI_A TIE

name: sub_482D4
role: DMA receive channel setup, ch0

name: sub_5615C
role: SCI_A ERI/RXI interrupt handler, vectors 148 and 149

name: sub_5683E
role: frame assembler and receive dispatcher: accumulates into 0xFFB0E0, verifies the trailing checksum, dispatches on the opcode

name: sub_56A94
role: voice / data frame handler for opcodes 0xA6-0xAB and 0xB6-0xBB

name: sub_58FA2
role: finalise and queue a command frame: length from buf[0], 0xFFB13A = 0xFFB13E, compute and store the checksum

name: sub_58F86
role: send the canned VER? packet at ROM 0x5901E; reached only through the request table at 0x5A3CE, index 0

name: sub_58F94
role: send the canned STOP ENCODE packet at ROM 0x5903E

name: sub_58F2A
role: build the ACK frame, opcode 0x20, in 0xFFB1A0

name: sub_58EE6
role: build the NAK frame, opcode 0x10, in 0xFFB1A0

name: request table
role: 32-bit table of packet builders indexed by 0xFFB0B6 x 4; entry 0 = sub_58F86 VER?, entry 9 = sub_58F94 STOP ENCODE

name: state table
role: 32-bit table of link states indexed by 0xFFB0A6 x 4: 0x56490, sub_564FA, sub_56520, 0x565BC, 0x565BE, sub_565C0, sub_565C0, 0x566C2, sub_566C4, sub_566E4, sub_56732, sub_5678E, sub_567DC

name: trace string table
role: string pointer table for the CPU>DSP / DSP>CPU ASCII trace, loaded at 0x56420

name: sub_5A482
role: ACK/NAK trace formatter, reads 0xFFB1A0

name: CPU>DSP trace formatter
role: full command switch at 0x5A53E

name: DSP>CPU trace formatter
role: full response switch at 0x5A82A

name: sub_5A0B4 / sub_5A0C0
role: opcode 0x15 table upload, subtype 0x01 = 18 records, subtype 0x11 = 6 records

name: sub_5DCDA
role: DSP WRITE MODE entry: 0xFFB0C4 = 1, bset bit0 of 0xFFFF52

name: sub_5DD00
role: DSP WRITE MODE state machine 0xFFB0C4 = 0..7: reset pulse on 0xFFFF52 bit3, boot bit4, sub_78222 async reconfig, handshake on 0xFFFF49 bit7, then sub_7815C

name: sub_103C0
role: mode entry that clears 0xFFB0C4 and dispatches mode code 0xEE through sub_3FF10

name: sub_5E9E2
role: maps 0xFFB0C4 to the progress pair shown on the SUB screen: (0,0), (1,3), (1,6), (2,0x0A)

name: sub_78222 / sub_7823C / sub_78256
role: reconfigure SCI_A to async 8-N-2, BRR 0x0C, SCR 0x70

name: sub_7815C
role: queue pump for the generic serial engine whose control block is at 0xFF6288; drains one queue to the DSP SCI

name: polled TX loop
role: wait SSR.TDRE, write 0xFFFF8B, clear TDRE; up to 0x40 bytes per call

name: sub_74310
role: sends the DSP version to SUB as inter-processor message id 0x5A, length 3, payload = the word at 0xFFB0DC

name: sub_74364
role: inter-processor message id 0x5B, length 4, 3 bytes from 0xFF813F

name: version gate
role: cmp.w #0x041E against the DSP version word at 0xFFB0DC; two different command sets depending on the DSP firmware

name: sub_FFF00ED1
role: version screen: formats bytes 0x21..0x29 of the shared status block at SUB RAM 0x00008C4D into Main Ver., Sub Ver. and DSP Ver.

name: sub_FFF0DE56
role: the ---DSP WRITE MODE---- screen; reads bytes 0x20 and 0x21 of 0x00008C4D as the progress state

name: template strings
role: Main Ver.  :  .    / Sub  Ver.  :  .    / DSP  Ver.  :  .     at 0xFFF487EC, 0xFFF48800, 0xFFF48814

name: DSP write strings
role: ---DSP WRITE MODE----, Push DISP Key! 0xFFF4AD0E, Loading... 0xFFF4AD1D, Complete 0xFFF4AD28, FIRM ERROR 0xFFF4AB44
